# Universal Mind / I AM

> Universal Mind is the company. I AM is its first experience: live electronic music television for mental health.

Check in. Unlock exclusive content. Watch electronic music television, together as one. With your permission, connect with personalised content, real-time community support and trusted mental-health referral pathways—inside the places you already trust, where you already spend your time.

Not another mental-health app. A privacy-first support layer within electronic music, fashion and culture.

Important context:

- I AM is a voluntary experience. Personalisation and support connections depend on permission.
- Universal Mind's current wellbeing features are not diagnosis and do not replace qualified clinical care.
- The Science record distinguishes established evidence, developing evidence, product translation and research still requiring product-specific testing.
- The three full research dossiers retain their Internet of Happiness [ I o H ] identity and compile cited peer-reviewed and institutional research relevant to the planned Epigenetics of Happiness study.

## Start here

- [Induction](https://universalmind.tv/vogue/iam/induction.html): The invitation, intended audience, privacy principles and role of trusted cultural spaces.
- [About I AM](https://universalmind.tv/vogue/iam/about.html): The complete public briefing on the problem, solution, experience, access model and research direction.
- [Program](https://universalmind.tv/vogue/iam/program.html): Watch one of 13 livestream electronic music and fashion channels across our curated worlds - Inner Planes, Champagne Bohemia, modul8 infinity, James Bondage Health and Safety Cushion.
- [Science](https://universalmind.tv/vogue/iam/science.html): The live evidence record, evidence grades, research limitations and clinical boundaries.
- [I AM Sound prototype record](https://universalmind.tv/vogue/iam/sound-prototype-research.html): A de-identified, unpublished n=1 internal observation with all three recorded biometric sessions, the complete fixed intervention and full limitations.
- [Our Team](https://universalmind.tv/vogue/iam/our-team.html): The people and experience behind Universal Mind.

## I AM experience

- [Check in](https://universalmind.tv/vogue/iam/vogue-self-report.html): The voluntary self-report entry into I AM.

- [Citizen Needs technology](https://universalmind.tv/vogue/iam/technology-citizen-needs.html): The public explanation of the privacy-first inference model used to interpret changing needs.
- [Adaptive Content Matrix](https://universalmind.tv/vogue/iam/technology-inference-engine.html): Learn how Universal Mind recommends music, fashion, brain entrainment and mantra content in response to a voluntary check-in.

## Universal Informatics

Bioinformatics platform for mental health. Research hypotheses remain distinct from mathematical verification and biological evidence.

## Initial focus · Computer vision for genomics

Inspired by research into how geometric architectures and Fibonacci-ordered dynamics can protect quantum information, we are investigating whether geometry derived from Fibonacci Pisano periods can improve the computational efficiency of hyperspectral image analysis for genomics.

Our proposed approach explores equilateral triangular meshes and tetrahedral models, comparing computational cost, processing speed and accuracy against established methods.

## Read without a connector

- [Research and evidence](https://universalmind.tv/informatics/read/): Plain HTML overview.
- [Publications](https://universalmind.tv/informatics/read/publications/index.html): 821 approved records, citations, summaries, limitations and topic assessment context.
- [Geometry Atlas](https://universalmind.tv/informatics/read/atlas/index.html): 1,001 records with complete JSON and CSV links.
- [Experiments](https://universalmind.tv/informatics/read/experiments/index.html): Versioned measurements, methods and limitations.
- [Data and methods](https://universalmind.tv/informatics/read/data.html): Full source inventory and checksums.
- [Archive record](https://universalmind.tv/informatics/read/provenance.html): Verified storage and timestamp status.
- [AI access and reuse](https://universalmind.tv/informatics/read/access.html): All LLM providers may read and train on Universal Mind-owned public Informatics material. Third-party rights remain attached to original material.
- [Connect and download](https://universalmind.tv/informatics/connect.html): Optional API, MCP, A2A and complete JSON/CSV exports.

Staging is excluded. No public GitHub repository is asserted until a public source release exists.
